review:
3 Lucky Monkeys Hold & Win is a classic-style 5x3, 20-line slot with Asian fortune symbols and gold coins. Special coins that land in the base game fly to one of three monkey pots above the reels, labelled Expand, Collect and Boost, and each pot shows how much it will contribute once the bonus opens.

When the Hold & Win round starts, those pots upgrade it: Expand can enlarge the grid, Collect gathers coin values and Boost raises them. Five jackpots are available inside the feature, from Mini up to Grand and a Royal top prize, and filling a fully expanded grid awards the 5,000x maximum. BGaming rates it medium volatility with a 96.98% RTP. Watching the pots fill gives the base game a real sense of progress.
pros: Second route to big wins via respins or jackpots
Full game playable in the official free demo
cons: Short-session results can differ widely from the RTP
